name: Corporate Creations
old_description: Established in 1995 and based right here in Omaha Nebraska, Corporate Creations specializes in custom screen printing, embroidery and promotional products for the Omaha Metro area including Ralston, Bellevue, Millard, Elkhorn, LaVista and Papillion.
about:
Corporate Creations was founded in 1995 in Omaha, Nebraska, by Wade Lewis while he was an undergraduate at the University of Nebraska at Omaha. Lewis initially launched Greek Creations to serve fraternity and sorority merchandise needs, and the success of that venture led friends and family to request similar custom screen printing, embroidery, and promotional products for their own organizations. Corporate Creations was born from that demand and remains headquartered at 9001 F Street in Omaha, serving the surrounding metro communities including Ralston, Bellevue, Millard, Elkhorn, LaVista, and Papillion.

The company provides custom decoration services centered on screen printing and embroidery, supplemented by a promotional product sourcing program that offers access to over 700,000 items. In-house capabilities include graphic design, digitizing for embroidery, art proofing with a 48-hour turnaround, and rush production options. Orders are produced at their Omaha facility with typical lead times of 10 business days after art approval. Minimum order quantities are set at six pieces for embroidery, 12 pieces for screen printing, and 100 pieces for most promotional products, though embroidery reorders carry no minimum.

Corporate Creations serves a broad base of local clients: businesses, clubs, sports teams, churches, charities, schools, universities, and non‑profit organizations throughout the Omaha metro area. The company also continues to support Greek‑life organizations through its affiliated brand Greek Creations. Customers range from small community groups to larger corporate accounts, all receiving the same design‑to‑delivery workflow.

The business was started to simplify and improve the way groups purchased custom merchandise, and that mission persists in a focus on low minimums, transparent pricing, and a collaborative art process that includes two free revisions. The company highlights its award‑winning design team and its recognition as Omaha Magazine’s Best of Omaha Custom T‑Shirt Store winner from 2021 through 2025 as evidence of its service quality.
